title: Conflicting empty-time requirements
description: EVT-01.c says an omitted time blocks saving; EVT-02.h says an empty time means 0:00.
resolution: Product Owner decision: an empty start uses now and an empty end uses the configured default event length.

title: An agent used git stash on the shared tree during Sprint 013
description: Ito ran git stash and pop while other agents were editing; for about a minute their files were at HEAD. The Kobayashi audit checked every handoff behavior and found no lost edit. resolution: No edit lost (Kobayashi audit); brief for the next sprint says: no git stash or checkout

description: The one-day-in-scrum skill asks Kobayashi to review each increment; on Days 1 and 2 one agent did every role and no independent review ran; run it before the Sprint 014 review. Update 2026-11-24: the independent code review ran (kobayashi_code_review.md); roles stay collapsed only in planning and development days. Open action: separate role agents for those steps next sprint. Update 2026-11-24 (retrospective): developers reviewed their own work and code review finding 5 slipped through; Sprint 015 planning and every development day use separate role agents with Kobayashi reviewing each wave before its PBIs go In Review (owner Takahashi); stays Open until that runs. Update 2026-11-24 (Sprint 015 Day 1): Day 1 ran with separate role agents (Nakamura; Yamamoto; Tanaka; Ito; Suzuki; Takahashi); Kobayashi's Day 1 review (kobayashi_code_review.md) found wave 0 done as planned with no must-fix (6 findings: 1 should; 5 notes); stays Open until the wave reviews (tasks 12 and 16) run. Update 2026-11-24 (Sprint 015 Day 2): Day 2 ran with separate role agents; Kobayashi's task 12 review (kobayashi_code_review.md) found wave 1 done as planned with no must-fix (2 should: the stale read fixed by Ito; the Windows and web check noted in verification 46); stays Open until task 16 runs. Update 2026-11-24 (Sprint 015 Day 3): Day 3 ran with separate role agents (Nakamura; Ito; Tanaka; Yamamoto; Suzuki; Takahashi); Kobayashi's task 16 review (kobayashi_code_review.md) found wave 2 done as planned with no must-fix (1 should: the refused write reason now backlog item PBI-129; 7 notes); both wave reviews (tasks 12 and 16) have now run.
resolution: The open action is met: Sprint 015 planning and every development day ran with separate role agents and Kobayashi reviewed each wave (Day 1 wave 0; task 12 wave 1; task 16 wave 2) before its PBIs went In Review; the practice continues as the plan for later sprints.
